findings.title: Wimmer axioms do not imply near-zero EU for endpoint mixture
findings.claim: Equal endpoint Dirac mixture has near-zero EU under the cited axiomatic view
findings.suspect_step: Converts number-of-remaining-models intuition into a consequence of Wimmer A2/A3
findings.assumptions: Binary probability simplex; bothQ valid; Q_U uniform; Q_B equal endpoints; mean-preserving spread defined by conditional mean-zero noise
findings.check: U uniform, B|U=u Bernoulli(u); E[B-U|U]=0. WeakA3 givesEU(Q_B)>=EU(Q_U), A2givesreverse, hencebothmaximal. StrictA3 incompatiblewithA2onpair.
findings.counterevidence: Wimmer discusses knowledge-versus-disagreement intuition, but does not derive near-zero. No claim to construct metric satisfying inconsistent full axioms.
findings.core_dependency: First advertised theoretical example for fundamental uncertainty conflicts; its strongest quantitative contrast fails.

repair.status: unsupported inference identified; no full axiom-system repair claimed
repair.statement: Remove axiomatic near-zero claim or supply specified valid measure and verify its assumptions
